stem: A facility wants one amber-trichome percentage to define harvest readiness for every cultivar it grows. Which response best matches the evidence?
choices: Use the same percentage because genotype does not affect trichome development
Do not treat one universal percentage as definitive; validate maturity using repeated representative observations for the cultivar and production objective
Replace direct observations with a fixed number of flowering days
Use only the most mature-looking flower from each crop
rationale: Research shows genotype- and age-dependent trichome development and asynchronous maturation. A single universal color percentage should therefore not be treated as a definitive harvest rule across cultivars.
